testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a selection containing an open and a closed drawing ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it ✔ And the user opens only the staged OpenDrawingA.odd ✔ Given a saved drawing is already open in a tab in the MCAD Software ✔ And a second saved drawing with available references is not open ✔ And the Open dialog displays the exact files for both drawings ✔ And `OpenDrawingA.odd` is open and `OpenDrawingB.odd` is closed ✔ When the user selects both drawings and chooses Open ✔ Then the Open dialog closes ✔ And the previously open drawing retains its existing tab without a duplicate ✔ And the second drawing opens in a new tab ✔ And the second drawing is active with its sheet displayed
